mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_dept_master ( dept_code, company_code, dept_name, upper_dept_no, dept_level, start_date, end_date, status, rm ) VALUES ( fn_make_code('DEPT'), #{companyCode}, #{deptName}, #{upperDeptNo}, #{deptLevel}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, #{rm} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_dept_master SET dept_name = #{deptName}, dept_level = #{deptLevel}, upper_dept_no = #{upperDeptNo}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, status = #{status}, rm = #{rm}, updated_by = #{userId}, update_date = SYSDATE WHERE company_code = #{companyCode} AND dept_code = #{deptCode}

UPDATE tb_dept_master target SET (target.dept_level, target.updated_by, target.update_date) = ( -- ⭐️ 레벨 계산 및 업데이트 정보를 한 번의 서브쿼리로 가져옴 SELECT (#{deptLevel} + t.lvl - 1), -- 새 레벨 계산 #{userId}, -- 업데이트 사용자 ID SYSDATE -- 업데이트 시각 FROM ( SELECT dept_code, LEVEL AS lvl -- 계층 구조 상의 깊이 (level) FROM tb_dept_master START WITH dept_code = #{deptCode} CONNECT BY PRIOR dept_code = upper_dept_no AND PRIOR company_code = company_code AND company_code = #{companyCode} ) t WHERE t.dept_code = target.dept_code -- 대상 테이블과 조인 ) WHERE target.company_code = #{companyCode} -- 2. DPT00035와 그 모든 하위 부서만 대상으로 지정 AND target.dept_code IN ( SELECT dept_code FROM tb_dept_master START WITH dept_code = #{deptCode} CONNECT BY PRIOR dept_code = upper_dept_no AND PRIOR company_code = company_code AND company_code = #{companyCode} )
